introduction: Catholic Charities’ Bakersfield office offers basic-needs assistance. Ask the office which services are currently available locally.
description: Catholic Charities’ Bakersfield office offers basic-needs assistance. Ask the office which services are currently available locally.

sections.who: The organization serves people in need regardless of religion. Individual services may require their own intake and evidence.
sections.get: Listed services include food, clothing, diapers and emergency assistance. Funding and local availability affect support.
sections.docs:
• Ask for the relevant service’s document checklist.
  • Household details and any urgent notice for assistance intake.
sections.apply:
1. Contact Bakersfield

    Call 661-281-2130 or use Catholic Charities.

  2. Confirm the service

    Ask about eligibility, intake and supplies before visiting 825 Chester Avenue.

  3. Complete intake

    Provide requested records and explain urgent needs.
sections.after: Ask for another referral when a service is unavailable. Confirm hours before travel.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Catholic Charities services and Bakersfield contact. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: The organization says services are provided regardless of religion.
Ask about the food pantry’s intake.
Get the checklist for the particular service first.
